propositions: A dockerized Jira 8.17.1 harness must be built from a vendored Dockerfile (not pulled) to serve as a real Data Center oracle for contract testing, since Atlassian ended new DC license sales and no official OpenAPI spec exists.

The harness Dockerfile must pin the addono base image by digest, include -DskipAllPrompts=true and -Dproduct.start.timeout on the atlas-run entrypoint, and be documented with rationale so load-bearing flags are not accidentally removed.

Jira DC instance must bind only to loopback (127.0.0.1:2990:2990), run with tty/stdin_open enabled, mount a persistent Maven cache volume, and execute only on native amd64 runners because emulated arm64 cannot reach readiness within practical timeouts.
Smoke tests must prove REST v2 semantics, programmatically-minted Personal Access Token bearer authentication, and index-independent teardown via direct issue endpoint polling for 404 responses.
The harness must be gated behind both REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1 opt-in and a jira_live canary that fails the session if collected tests never execute, preventing silent validation vacuity.

CI job in external-integration.yml must build the Dockerfile, wait on readiness probe with generous timeout, run only harness tests, and tear down under if:always(); the pre-existing external job must exclude harness tests to keep its own canary meaningful.
